decisions.reason: The request for sensible and credible numbers strengthens model integrity but does not change the existing government-facing narrative, projected-status disclosure, or availability-payment message.
The source does not change how assumptions must be annotated or which materials serve as their reference basis.
Credibility of resulting figures concerns data and formula integrity; the source does not change the model's presentation, understandability, or auditability requirements.
The general quality instruction does not alter the capex estimate, midpoint basis, provisional status, or treatment of shared costs.
The source does not change the availability-payment sizing targets, required conclusion, or justification criteria.
The source does not change the debt-equity split, debt cost, mezzanine treatment, or financing structure.
The request for credible numbers does not replace or otherwise modify the confirmed CAD 30–40M annual operating-cost basis.
The source does not change the Business Case site list selected as authoritative for the model.
